evidence: For adults with septic shock on vasopressors, we recommend an initial target mean arterial pressure (MAP) of 65 mm Hg over higher MAP targets
note: Initial resuscitation target for adults with septic shock on vasopressors; the comparison direction (exact vs. at least 65) is not stated in the recommendation, so operator is left null. Not a patient risk condition.

evidence: While some tissues, such as the brain and kidneys have the ability to auto-regulate blood flow, MAPs below a threshold, usually understood to be approximately 60 mm Hg, are associated with decreased organ perfusion, which tracks linearly with MAP [79].
note: Threshold described as approximately 60 mm Hg; decreased organ perfusion mapped to OrganHypoperfusion.
